title: Coordinate angle
description: Calculate and set angles based on coordinates!

## **Coordinate angle**

**📋• Info**

With Coordinate Angle you can set the angle you're looking at by setting a custom angle or by inputting X and Z coordinates. As well as locking your view to the angle you're looking at!

**🔧• Features**


Coordinate angle adds 3 commands used to set your angle and lock view.

<details>
<summary>/angle <angle></summary>

Use **/angle** to set your view to a certain angle.
Example: /angle -33.8425 (do not input °)

![angle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7756b5b337fa7a162e136864a7b6f96c632d512c.png)

</details>


<details>
<summary>/coordinate_angle <x> <z></summary>

Use **/coordinate_angle <x> <z>** to set your view to these exact coordinates.
Example: /coordinate_angle -38.2 180342.7302

![angle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7756b5b337fa7a162e136864a7b6f96c632d512c.png)

</details>


<details>
<summary>/viewlock</summary>

Use **/viewlock** to enable/disable locking your view to the angle you are looking at.

![Viewlock on](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3130da12a35317dbab7e3b1289b51ce65299d87f.png)![Viewlock off](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5f2748ac21dbd92416b19de88d3a234fb2cfd6b1.png)

</details>
